policy.candidate_pool: all prepared Top20; also fixed Top10 prefix
policy.geometry: Native pixels: 8-connected components; scipy fill_holes default4 background; baseline adjacency Chebyshev1; edge=mask minus 3x3 erosion
policy.strata: hole_fraction>=0.5 first; else any baseline adjacency; edge_fraction>=0.5 fragment; remaining detached_region
policy.interpretation: Geometry proxies, not whole-object/semantic ground truth; fixed thresholds are descriptive, never online filtering
policy.errors: TP>FP proxy, not semantic annotation; parse/truncation/unknown retained separately
policy.denominator: Candidate confusion counts include overlapping candidates; pixel TP/FP use per-image union within each stratum; different strata may overlap and must not be summed as a global pixel count
